title: oval — overleaf

sentences.sentence: ...the small oval framed picture of a little boy.
sentences.translation: …一个小男孩的镶在椭圆形框架里的小幅照片。

phrases.translation: 长时间起立鼓掌；起立致敬

sentences.sentence: The Chancellor’s entrance was greeted with a standing ovation (= everyone stood up ).
sentences.translation: 总理进来时，全体起立鼓掌欢迎。

sentences.sentence: Fans gave the rock group a thunderous ovation.
sentences.translation: 歌迷对这个摇滚乐队报以雷鸣般的掌声。

phrases.translation: 真空干燥箱，真空烘箱；真空电炉

sentences.sentence: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees C.
sentences.translation: 把烤箱预热至200摄氏度。

sentences.sentence: Press the mixture onto the bread and bake in a hot oven for ten minutes.
sentences.translation: 把混合料抹在面包上，然后在烤箱内高温烘烤10分钟。

phrases.translation: 到处，遍及；浑身；全部结束
复习，重温；仔细检查；转变；润色
adv. 一再地；反复不断地
招待某人在家吃饭 (或饮酒等)
在…对面；正对着；与…相反；与…形成对照
煎半熟蛋；煎两面；结束容易

sentences.sentence: You really should come over and see our new house.
sentences.translation: 你真的该过来看看我们的新房子。

sentences.sentence: I spent the whole day over at Gabby’s place.
sentences.translation: 我一整天都在加比家。

sentences.sentence: We could drive over to Oxford this afternoon.
sentences.translation: 今天下午我们可以开车到牛津去。

translations.translation: 全部的；全体的；一切在内的

phrases.translation: 整个项目；全面计划方案

sentences.sentence: The overall cost of the exhibition was £400,000.
sentences.translation: 展览会的全部费用是40万英镑。

sentences.sentence: The overall result is an increase in population.
sentences.translation: 总的结果是人口增加。

sentences.sentence: An overall winner and a runner-up were chosen.
sentences.translation: 总冠军和第二名被选了出来。

sentences.sentence: We don’t want all the details now, just the overall picture.
sentences.translation: 现在我们不需要全部细节，只要知道大致的情况。

translations.translation: 极其热心的；全身心投入的

sentences.sentence: His sailing instructor fell overboard and nearly drowned during a lesson.
sentences.translation: 他的帆船教练在一次课上落水，差点溺死。

sentences.sentence: a chilly overcast day
sentences.translation: 一个寒冷的阴天

sentences.sentence: The sky was overcast and a light rain began to fall.
sentences.translation: 天空阴云密布，并下起了小雨。

sentences.sentence: I sprang 400 pounds for  her overcoat.
sentences.translation: 给她买那件大衣，我花了400镑。

sentences.sentence: He placed his cap and overcoat on a chair.
sentences.translation: 他把帽子和大衣搁在一张椅子上。

sentences.sentence: She removed all the grease stains from her overcoat.
sentences.translation: 她把她大衣上所有油渍都去掉了。

sentences.sentence: He struggled to overcome his shyness.
sentences.translation: 他努力克服自己的羞怯。

sentences.sentence: Her financial problems could no longer be overcome.
sentences.translation: 她的经济困难再也无法解决。

translations.translation: 使过度拥挤；把…塞得过满

sentences.sentence: Do not overcrowd the fish.
sentences.translation: 不要过度拥挤的鱼。

translations.translation: 把…做得过分；使过于疲劳；对…表演过火；夸张

sentences.sentence: Analysts believe that worries about the economy are overdone.
sentences.translation: 分析人士认为对经济的担忧有些过火了。

sentences.sentence: Use a few drawings and photographs, but don’t overdo it.
sentences.translation: 可使用一些图画和照片，但不要太多。

sentences.sentence: He'd overdosed on heroin.
sentences.translation: 他过量吸食了海洛因。

translations.translation: [金融] 透支；[金融] 透支额

sentences.sentence: a £250 overdraft
sentences.translation: 250英镑的透支额

sentences.sentence: Many students have a free overdraft facility (= agreement with their bank to have an overdraft up to a particular limit ).
sentences.translation: 许多学生都能享受免费透支服务。

phrases.translation: 逾期未支付款；过期付款

sentences.sentence: an overdue gas bill
sentences.translation: 逾期未付的煤气账单

sentences.sentence: The library books are overdue.
sentences.translation: 图书馆的书过期未还。

sentences.sentence: The baby was a week overdue (= it was expected to be born a week ago ).
sentences.translation: 宝宝超过预产期有一周了。

translations.translation: 充满，洋溢；泛滥；超值；溢值

phrases.translation: 栈溢出；堆叠溢位；堆栈上限溢位

sentences.sentence: The drains flooded and water overflowed down the main street.
sentences.translation: 下水道被淹，水溢到了大街上。

sentences.sentence: The river had overflowed its banks.
sentences.translation: 河水漫堤了。

sentences.sentence: a lawn with overgrown grass
sentences.translation: 杂草丛生的草地

sentences.sentence: I overheard part of their conversation.
sentences.translation: 我碰巧听到了他们谈话的部分内容。

sentences.sentence: I couldn’t help overhearing your argument.
sentences.translation: 我无意中听到了你们的争吵。

translations.translation: 使…万分高兴；使…狂喜（overjoy的过去分词）

sentences.sentence: Shelley was overjoyed to see me.
sentences.translation: 谢莉看见我高兴极了。

translations.translation: 部分重叠；部分的同时发生

sentences.sentence: a large degree of overlap
sentences.translation: 很大程度上的重叠

sentences.sentence: When the bag is folded, the bottom overlaps one side.
sentences.translation: 把包折叠起来时，其底部与一边就重合了。

sentences.sentence: Overlap the slices carefully so there are no gaps.
sentences.translation: 把薄片小心地叠放在一起，那样就没有间隙。

sentences.sentence: See the diagram overleaf.
sentences.translation: 参见背面的示意图。

text:
英语词汇 · 专八 · 第 422 单元

oval
音标：英 /'əʊv(ə)l/  美 /'ovl/
adj. 椭圆的；卵形的
n. 椭圆形；卵形
短语：oval office — 美国总统办公室
短语：oval window — 卵圆窗
例句：...the small oval framed picture of a little boy.
…一个小男孩的镶在椭圆形框架里的小幅照片。

ovation
音标：英 /ə(ʊ)'veɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /o'veʃən/
n. 热烈欢迎；大喝采
短语：standing ovation — 长时间起立鼓掌；起立致敬
例句：The Chancellor’s entrance was greeted with a standing ovation (= everyone stood up ).
总理进来时，全体起立鼓掌欢迎。
例句：Fans gave the rock group a thunderous ovation.
歌迷对这个摇滚乐队报以雷鸣般的掌声。

oven
音标：英 /'ʌv(ə)n/  美 /'ʌvn/
n. 炉，灶；烤炉，烤箱
短语：coke oven — 炼焦炉
短语：microwave oven — 微波炉
短语：oven gas — 焦炉煤气
短语：coke oven gas — 焦炉煤气
短语：drying oven — 干燥箱
短语：electric oven — n. 电烤炉；电烘炉
短语：oven heating — 烘箱加热；加热固化
短语：vacuum oven — 真空干燥箱，真空烘箱；真空电炉
短语：micro-wave oven — 微波炉
短语：baking oven — n. 烘箱
短语：gas oven — 煤气炉；烤箱
短语：electromagnetic oven — 电磁炉
短语：air oven — 烘箱，烤箱；热空气箱
短语：toaster oven — 烤炉；烤箱
短语：electronic oven — 电烤箱，电子炉
短语：curing oven — 固化炉；硬化炉；熟化炉
例句：Preheat the oven to 200 degrees C.
把烤箱预热至200摄氏度。
例句：Press the mixture onto the bread and bake in a hot oven for ten minutes.
把混合料抹在面包上，然后在烤箱内高温烘烤10分钟。

over
音标：英 /'əʊvə/  美 /'ovɚ/
adv. 结束；越过；从头到尾
prep. 越过；在…之上；遍于…之上
adj. 结束的；上面的
vt. 越过
n. (Over)人名；(俄、西、土)奥韦尔
短语：all over — 到处，遍及；浑身；全部结束
短语：over there — adv. 在那里
短语：over and over — 反复；再三
短语：go over — 复习，重温；仔细检查；转变；润色
短语：over with — 做完，完成；结束
短语：over and over again — adv. 一再地；反复不断地
短语：over here — adv. 这里；在这边
短语：have someone over — 招待某人在家吃饭 (或饮酒等)
短语：over against — 在…对面；正对着；与…相反；与…形成对照
短语：over and above — 除…之外；在…之上
短语：do over — 重做；粉刷
短语：be all over someone — [口语]巴结(或讨好)某人
短语：over easy — 煎半熟蛋；煎两面；结束容易
短语：over and done with — 完结
例句：You really should come over and see our new house.
你真的该过来看看我们的新房子。
例句：I spent the whole day over at Gabby’s place.
我一整天都在加比家。
例句：We could drive over to Oxford this afternoon.
今天下午我们可以开车到牛津去。

overall
音标：英 /'əʊvərɔːl/  美 /,ovə'rɔl/
adj. 全部的；全体的；一切在内的
adv. 全部地；总的说来
n. 工装裤；罩衫
短语：overall situation — 大局；总体形势
短语：overall quality — 综合质量；总的质量
短语：overall development — 综合开发
短语：overall planning — 整体规划；全面规划
短语：overall design — 总体设计；总设计
短语：overall performance — 整体性能；总指标
短语：overall level — 总电平
短语：overall structure — 总体结构，整体结构
短语：overall plan — 总体规划
短语：overall analysis — 全分析
短语：overall system — [计]总体系统
短语：overall strength — 总强度
短语：overall evaluation — 综合评价
短语：overall strategy — 全面战略
短语：overall efficiency — 总效率
短语：overall budget — 总体预算
短语：overall cost — 总成本；全部成本；总值
短语：overall view — 全景；透视图
短语：overall project — 整个项目；全面计划方案
短语：overall risk — 综合险，整体风险
例句：The overall cost of the exhibition was £400,000.
展览会的全部费用是40万英镑。
例句：The overall result is an increase in population.
总的结果是人口增加。
例句：An overall winner and a runner-up were chosen.
总冠军和第二名被选了出来。
例句：We don’t want all the details now, just the overall picture.
现在我们不需要全部细节，只要知道大致的情况。

overboard
音标：英 /'əʊvəbɔːd/  美 /'ovɚbɔrd/
adv. 自船上落下；向船外
adj. 极其热心的；全身心投入的
短语：go overboard — 过火；鲁莽从事
例句：His sailing instructor fell overboard and nearly drowned during a lesson.
他的帆船教练在一次课上落水，差点溺死。

overcast
音标：英 /'əʊvəkɑːst/  美 /,ovɚ'kæst/
adj. 阴天的；阴暗的；愁闷的
v. 使沮丧；包缝；遮蔽
短语：overcast sky — 阴天
例句：a chilly overcast day
一个寒冷的阴天
例句：The sky was overcast and a light rain began to fall.
天空阴云密布，并下起了小雨。

overcoat
音标：英 /'əʊvəkəʊt/  美 /'ovɚkot/
n. 大衣，外套
例句：I sprang 400 pounds for  her overcoat.
给她买那件大衣，我花了400镑。
例句：He placed his cap and overcoat on a chair.
他把帽子和大衣搁在一张椅子上。
例句：She removed all the grease stains from her overcoat.
她把她大衣上所有油渍都去掉了。

overcome
音标：英 /əʊvə'kʌm/  美 /,ovɚ'kʌm/
v. 克服；胜过
短语：overcome difficulties — 克服困难；战胜困难
例句：He struggled to overcome his shyness.
他努力克服自己的羞怯。
例句：Her financial problems could no longer be overcome.
她的经济困难再也无法解决。

overcrowd
音标：英 /əʊvə'kraʊd/  美 /,əuvə'kraud/
v. 使过度拥挤；把…塞得过满
例句：Do not overcrowd the fish.
不要过度拥挤的鱼。

overdo
音标：英 /əʊvə'duː/  美 /'ovɚ'dʊ/
v. 把…做得过分；使过于疲劳；对…表演过火；夸张
例句：Analysts believe that worries about the economy are overdone.
分析人士认为对经济的担忧有些过火了。
例句：Use a few drawings and photographs, but don’t overdo it.
可使用一些图画和照片，但不要太多。

overdose
音标：英 /'əʊvədəʊs/  美 /'ovɚdos/
v. 配药过量；使过分沉溺
n. 药量过多（等于overdosage）
短语：drug overdose — 药物过量；服药过量
例句：He'd overdosed on heroin.
他过量吸食了海洛因。

overdraft
音标：英 /'əʊvədrɑːft/  美 /'ovɚdræft/
n. [金融] 透支；[金融] 透支额
vt. [金融] 透支
短语：overdraft facility — （英）（银行存款）透支法
例句：a £250 overdraft
250英镑的透支额
例句：Many students have a free overdraft facility (= agreement with their bank to have an overdraft up to a particular limit ).
许多学生都能享受免费透支服务。

overdue
音标：英 /əʊvə'djuː/  美 /'ovɚ'dʊ/
adj. 过期的；迟到的；未兑的
短语：overdue payment — 逾期未支付款；过期付款
短语：overdue fine — 滞纳金；过期罚金
例句：an overdue gas bill
逾期未付的煤气账单
例句：The library books are overdue.
图书馆的书过期未还。
例句：The baby was a week overdue (= it was expected to be born a week ago ).
宝宝超过预产期有一周了。

overflow
音标：英 /əʊvə'fləʊ/  美 /,ovɚ'flo/
v. 溢出；泛滥；充溢
n. 充满，洋溢；泛滥；超值；溢值
短语：buffer overflow — 缓冲区溢出
短语：overflow valve — 溢流阀
短语：overflow weir — 溢流堰
短语：overflow with — 充满着
短语：stack overflow — 栈溢出；堆叠溢位；堆栈上限溢位
短语：overflow dam — 溢流堰
短语：overflow tank — 溢流罐
短语：overflow pipe — 下导管，溢流管
例句：The drains flooded and water overflowed down the main street.
下水道被淹，水溢到了大街上。
例句：The river had overflowed its banks.
河水漫堤了。

overgrown
音标：英 /əʊvə'grəʊn; 'əʊvəgrəʊn/  美 /,ovɚ'ɡron/
adj. 蔓生的；生长过快的
v. 生长过度（overgrow的过去分词）
例句：a lawn with overgrown grass
杂草丛生的草地

overhear
音标：英 /əʊvə'hɪə/  美 /,ovɚ'hɪr/
v. 无意中听到；偷听
例句：I overheard part of their conversation.
我碰巧听到了他们谈话的部分内容。
例句：I couldn’t help overhearing your argument.
我无意中听到了你们的争吵。

overjoyed
音标：英 /əʊvə'dʒɒɪd/  美 /,ovɚ'dʒɔɪd/
adj. 狂喜的；极度高兴的
v. 使…万分高兴；使…狂喜（overjoy的过去分词）
例句：Shelley was overjoyed to see me.
谢莉看见我高兴极了。

overlap
音标：英 /əʊvə'læp/  美 /'ovəlæp/
n. 重叠；重复
v. 部分重叠；部分的同时发生
短语：overlap ratio — 纵向重合度；重叠比
短语：overlap joint — 搭接接头；重迭结合
短语：overlap region — 重叠区；重叠区域
例句：a large degree of overlap
很大程度上的重叠
例句：When the bag is folded, the bottom overlaps one side.
把包折叠起来时，其底部与一边就重合了。
例句：Overlap the slices carefully so there are no gaps.
把薄片小心地叠放在一起，那样就没有间隙。

overleaf
音标：英 /əʊvə'liːf/  美 /,ovɚ'lif/
adv. 在次页；在背面
adj. 背面的；次页的
例句：See the diagram overleaf.
参见背面的示意图。
